% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{The Comparator (the network's foundational object)}} \\
\midrule

$\standing{i}$ ($\alpha_i$)
    & \textbf{The comparator}, realized on the graph as the exact
      post-debit balance/count mediant:
      \[
          \standing{i}
          =
          \frac{
              \displaystyle\sum_{u}
                  \transportentry{u}{i}\,\burnbal{u}
          }{
              \displaystyle\sum_{u}
                  \transportentry{u}{i}\,\actcount{u}
          }.
      \]
      The sum runs over \emph{all} sources including $u=i$, which enters
      through the self column $\transportentry{i}{i}>0$; every anchored
      source satisfies $\actcount{u}\ge1$, so no guard is needed.
      Under uniform action counts the formula reduces to the familiar
      rate-DeGroot average, but the mediant is normative.
      Its value-channel role is
      \zcref{ins:comparator:universal-amplifier}; bounded by
      \zcref{prop:epoch:final-standing-hull}; enters the projected
      target activation via $p = x/(1+x)$ on reduced standing.
      \emph{Canonical macro} \texttt{\textbackslash standing}; the glyph is
      $\alpha$ ($\alpha_i$ with the actor index). Distinct from diversity
      preference $\divpref$ ($q$)
      and from per-actor ``influence'': it is the cross-cluster comparator, not a
      per-actor effect. \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:final-standing}. \\

$\commitrate{i}$ ($r_i$)
    & The \textbf{neutral source}: the unique exogenous input to the standing
      recursion --- the one quantity the topology cannot generate
      (\zcref{post:comparator:frame-requirements}(i),(ii)). Defined as
      $\commitrate{i} = \burnbal{i}/\max(\actcount{i},1)$: it uses
      residual balance after consummated debits, not gross imported
      frame value, and is derivable from
      the public ledger without graph traversal. Per-actor only as an
      \emph{implementation} of the imported frame; the object that matters is the
      shared codomain it inhabits. Non-increasing in $\actcount{i}$ at fixed
      $\burnbal{i}$ (every action without a burn permanently dilutes it);
      non-decreasing in $\burnbal{i}$. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:comparator:rate}. \\

$\burnval{i}$ ($B_i$)
    & The \textbf{imported frame}, fiber-wise: $\burnval{i} \coloneqq
      \attest{\operatorname{key}(i)}$, the network's reading of the Layer~0
      attestation map (\attestationcref{def:operations:burn}). Non-decreasing at
      sampling depth (\zcref{lem:comparator:frame-stability}), publicly auditable,
      irrevocable --- all Layer~0 properties. The \emph{foundational content of
      the map is its shared ordered codomain} $\R_{\geq0}$, the single line onto
      which all addresses are forced; $\burnval{i}$ is the fiber, the
      comparator is the bundle (\zcref{def:comparator:imported-frame}). The
      codomain carries no glyph (it is inhabited, never typeset).
      \tagLzero{} \zcref{def:comparator:imported-frame}. \\

$\burncap$ ($B_{\max}$)
    & Bootstrap capacity bound, $\burncap \coloneqq \attestcap$: the maximum
      aggregate frame value before external deposits. The bound that holds the
      comparator source-faithful against the costless Sybil through the
      pre-market interval (\zcref{def:comparator:source-faithful}). Distinct from
      $\burnval{i}$ ($B_i$): subscript ``$\max$''.
      \tagLzero{} \zcref{def:comparator:bootstrap-capacity};
      \attestationcref{prop:interface:bootstrap-capacity}. \\

$\actcount{i}$ ($N_i$)
    & Cumulative action count of actor~$i$. Non-decreasing; the denominator of
      the neutral source. Irrevocably incremented by every action. Distinct from
      epoch length $\epochlen$ ($N_{\mathrm{epoch}}$): always use the macro with
      its subscript; never write $N_i$ bare alongside $N_{\mathrm{epoch}}$.
      \tagclosure{} \\

$\burnbal{i}$ ($b_i$)
            & Residual balance: imported frame net of consummated $\safethresh$-debits,
                  $\burnbal{i}=\burnval{i}-\sum_a\safethresh^{(k_a)}$. Numerator of the
                  neutral source and the object of W1. \tagclosure{}
                  \zcref{def:comparator:residual-balance}. \\

$\transportentry{u}{i}$ ($\symbf{\Pi}_{ui}$)
    & \textbf{Conserved transport entry}: the share of source~$u$'s single
      conserved unit that reaches~$i$.  It is a \emph{simplex coordinate},
      not an independent weight --- each row sums to one, so raising one
      recipient's entry lowers another's or the source's own.  It is not a
      raw Action-Graph path product and not a double-cover register; it is
      zero exactly when the base matrix affords no chain from $u$ to $i$
      at a supported depth.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:finite-depth-conserved-transport,%
      thm:epoch:standing-pair-mass-conservation}. \\

Person-vouch-eligible relation
    & A folded person-vouch relation designated by the closed standing
      census, authored by its projected source Actor, directed toward a
      person target, complete under standing atomicity, positive in every
      mandatory semantic coordinate, live, and non-self.  Predicate/rule;
      no glyph.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:effective-act-contribution}. \\

$\foldcoef{\xi}$ ($c(\xi)$)
    & Intrinsic relation coefficient, the geometric mean of the folded
      relation's mandatory positive semantic coordinates:
      \[
          \foldcoef{\xi}
          =
          \left(
              \prod_{\ell=1}^{m}s_\ell(\xi)
          \right)^{1/m}
          \in(0,1].
      \]
      Independent of raw leg count, maturity, temporal entropy, and
      passive-node incidence.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:effective-act-contribution}. \\

$\hopalloc{r}{u}{j}{\standingvector}$
($\lambda^{(r)}_{uj}(\symbf{x})$)
    & Hop-$r$ allocation share: the fraction of the mass source~$u$ is
      apportioning at that hop which goes to~$j$.  Each row sums to one over
      self and all authored recipients, so it is a simplex coordinate, never
      an independent weight:
      \[
          \hopalloc{r}{u}{j}{\standingvector}
          =
          \frac{\basescore{u}{j}\,
                \wallactivation{\standingstate{j}}^{\tiltexp{r}{\tiltstrength{k}}}}
               {\sum_v \basescore{u}{v}\,
                \wallactivation{\standingstate{v}}^{\tiltexp{r}{\tiltstrength{k}}}} .
      \]
      The self score is unmodulated.  Passive context is absent: only
      authored acts contribute to $\basescore{}{}$.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:hop-allocation-score}. \\

$\emission{u}$ ($\symfrak{e}_u$)
    & Source emission: the fraction of $u$'s history its present balance can
      carry outward, $\min(1,\refrate{u}/\safefloor)$, read from the
      epoch-final ledger and constant during the solve.  What is not exported
      is retained on $u$'s own diagonal, never deleted.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:source-emission}. \\

$\tiltstrength{k}$ ($t_k$)
    & Accepted tilt strength: the greatest rung of the published backoff grid
      whose certificate passes.  The anchor $\tiltstrength{k}=0$ is the exact
      no-tilt allocation rule and always certifies, which is what makes the
      ladder safely degradable.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:tilt-backoff-grid}. \\

$\hopmax$ ($L_{\mathrm{hop}}$)
    & Maximum projected standing depth, fixed to four complete
      person-vouch acts.  Distinct from raw feed depth~$L=4$.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:standing-depth-mass}. \\

$\netpd{}$, $\netpi{}$
    & Net stance parameters $\bar p_d$, $\bar p_i$ for a same-author, same-target,
      same-type bundle, recomputed at the epoch boundary by sum-then-clip. Used
      by complete person-vouch compilation after per-author bundle
      folding; raw feed, CAN, title, and payload consumers retain their
      declared raw inputs. Collision note: bar-$p$ distinguishes
      these from bond kernel $p$ (\zcref{def:epoch:raw-self-edge-reading}) and
      $\bar w$ edge-norm means (\zcref{def:can:transmission-coefficient}).
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:net-stance}. \\

$\numeraire$ (num\'eraire)
    & The \textbf{comparator's unit (num\'eraire)}: reserve units per
      action-credit, structural tier, and the sole join between the reserve
      economy (Layer~0) and the action economy (Layer~1). Every reserve input is
      divided by it before meeting a count; every reduced quantity is a
      $\numeraire$-reduction. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:comparator:numeraire,subsec:necessity:floor-as-numeraire}. \\

$\safethresh$ (safety threshold)
    & \textbf{Safety threshold} (reserve/action): the algorithmic clamp on
      the policy floor, published with one-boundary lead under R1--R7
      (\zcref{def:epoch:safety-threshold}). Bare $\safethresh$ is reserved;
      App~D's angles are subscripted. Never compared to a dimensionless
      quantity without explicit $\numeraire$. \tagclosure{} \\

$\polfloor$ (policy floor)
    & \textbf{Policy floor} (dimensionless): the host dial, announced at
      boundary~$k$, effective $k{+}1$, valid iff
      $\polfloor\numeraire \ge \safethresh$
      (\zcref{def:epoch:policy-floor}). \tagclosure{} \\

$\partfloor$ (effective floor)
    & \textbf{Effective participation floor}, derived:
      $\max(\polfloor, \safefloor)$ --- equal to $\polfloor$ on
      every valid certificate; the $\max$ is fault totalization with safe
      polarity. The only floor form at read-sites: gate, freeze, entry
      cost, App~D operating floor
      (\zcref{def:epoch:participation-floor}). \tagclosure{} \\

set price
            & Average member-author raw rate over a dependent set at the closing burn
                  snapshot; consumed by the closure rule and nothing else. Paired with the
                  individual safety floor: averaging can clear the door, but cannot mask a
                  member below $\safethresh$ (\zcref{post:epoch:final-act-sequence-write-rule}). \tagclosure{} \\

\multicolumn{2}{@{}p{0.96\linewidth}@{}}{\footnotesize
      \emph{No glyph (by design).} Accountability cost
      (\zcref{post:comparator:accountability-cost}), un-floored injection
      (\zcref{post:comparator:faithfulness}), complete person-vouch
      eligibility (\zcref{def:epoch:effective-act-contribution}), projection
      completeness (\zcref{prop:deployment:allocation-input-completeness}),
      cross-target rivalry, target consent, standing-transition budget,
      and privacy of departure
      (\zcref{frontier:structural-residue-reidentification}) are labels or
      predicates, not scalar quantities.} \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Two-Layer Architecture}} \\
\midrule

Layer~0 (Attestation)
            & The \textbf{frame source}. Exports the neutral attestation map
                  (\zcref{rem:comparator:neutrality-from-silence}); owns nothing of the graph.
                  \zcref{subsec:introduction:two-layers-derived}. \\

Layer~1 (Network)
    & \textbf{The binding}. Reads the frame, welds it onto the graph to produce
      $\standing{}$, and publishes the standing field, the ledger, and every
      scoring constant. Computes and publishes $\commitrate{i}$, $\transportentry{j}{i}$,
      $\standing{i}$, stamps, and door headroom at each epoch boundary. No content
      moderation; earns only the Layer~0 minting fee.
      \zcref{subsec:introduction:two-layers-derived}. \\

Layer~2 (Guild)
    & \textbf{Readouts}. Independent economic communities consuming $\standing{i}$
      to attribute and reward. Each publishes its own CAN recursion, parameters,
      and reward formula; none owns the graph or the frame. Three mandatory CAN
      invariants: depth decay, transmission $< 1$, context independence
      (\zcref{def:can:mandatory-guild-invariants}).
      \zcref{subsec:introduction:two-layers-derived,subsec:transport:guild-model}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Graph Structure (the gauge substrate)}} \\
\midrule

$G$
    & Graph $G = (V, E)$, $V = V_u \sqcup V_c$. The \emph{gauge substrate}: every
      quantity computed from $G$ alone is relabeling-invariant, hence fabricable,
      hence insufficient to compare clusters
      (\zcref{ax:comparator:inter-cluster}). The space the frame's intersection
      makes relative. \textbf{(---)} \zcref{def:graph:partition}. \\

$V_u, V_c$
    & Active (Actor) and passive (artifact) node sets. Every edge is authored by
      an active node or by Layer~1 on its behalf; no passive node autonomously
      originates or redirects an edge. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{ax:graph:passivity,lem:graph:passive-out-degree}. \\

$\symbf{\Psi}_e$
    & $3 \times 3$ extended sentiment slice of edge $e$. \emph{Shape}, not mass:
      tensor-geometric quantities are fabricable by effort and cannot, alone,
      compare clusters (\zcref{rem:comparator:topology-is-gauge}). \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:graph:sentiment-slice}. \\

$\symbf{\symcal{T}}_e$
    & $3 \times 3 \times 2$ augmented relevance tensor.
      $\norm{\symbf{\symcal{T}}}_F = \norm{\symbf{\Psi}}_F \cdot \sqrt{1+\tau^2}$.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{def:graph:augmented-tensor}. \\

$l_{ij}$
    & License severity $a_i + o_j \in [0,2]$. Metadata; never ingested by
      tensors. \tagLtwo{} \zcref{def:content:license-qualifiers}. \\

$\symbf{\Lambda}$
    & Global append-only registry mapping unique names to persistent CAN
      contribution nodes. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:can:compositional-attribution-network}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Dual-View Architecture (two readouts of the comparator)}} \\
\midrule

\PathView{}
    & Raw-graph tensor interface: $\bleedparam$-softened $2 \times 2$
      bilinear block for path composition.
      The discriminating readout (directional coherence). Determinant sign
      $\detsign{e}$ extracted here.  Terminal: used by feed, raw bridge,
      and raw signed services, not by standing. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:graph:dual-view-architecture,def:graph:path-view-extraction}. \\

\AttrView{}
    & Full $3 \times 3$ Frobenius norm as CAN base value. The equitable readout
      (total information, no temporal factor). \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:graph:dual-view-architecture,def:can:base-value}. \\

$\pathview{e}$
    & $\bleedparam$-softened $2 \times 2$ path-view matrix.  Terminal
      formula; a host-cached matrix is a by-product. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:graph:path-view-extraction}. \\

$\softmask{gh}$
    & Softened mask coefficient: $a_{gh} + (1-a_{gh})\bleedparam$. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{eq:graph:path-view-extraction}. \\

$\bleedparam$
    & Cross-dimensional bleed $\bleedparam \numrel{const.graph.bleed.num}$. Ensures $\det(\pathview{}) \neq 0$.
      Binding because it enters the projected standing activation core;
      also consumed by terminal raw path views.
      Distinct from retired adoption-decay nu (licensing). \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:path-view-extraction,%
def:epoch:responsive-vouch-activation}. \\

$\pathmatrix{p}$
    & $2 \times 2$ path matrix $\prod_e \pathview{e}$. The macro produces $P(p)$;
      the guild liquidity pool uses $\guildpool$. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:graph:path-matrix}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Signed Graph and Determinant Sign}} \\
\midrule

$\detsign{e}$
            & Per-edge determinant sign $\operatorname{sgn}(\det(\pathview{e}))
                  = \operatorname{sgn}(p_dp_i) \in \set{+1,-1}$
                  (\zcref{lem:graph:quadrant-law}). One-bit extraction from the
                  \PathView{} determinant; a coherence bit, not a favor bit
                  (\zcref{rem:graph:sign-semantics}).
      Structurally forced to $+1$ for Self~Dec/Rep, Withdraw, Rescind, Leave,
      De-invite/A·T, and Invitation/T.
      Used by raw feed/bridge/signed consumers and complete-act
      diagnostics where explicitly declared; it does not assign
      allocation share.  Canonical formula \tagLtwo{}; host-cached value
      \tagbyproduct{}.
      \zcref{def:graph:determinant-sign}. \\

$\detsign{p}$
    & Path parity sign $\prod_{e \in p} \detsign{e} =
      \operatorname{sgn}(\det(\pathmatrix{p}))$. Computable at $O(1)$ per edge.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{cor:graph:path-parity-sign}. \\

Positive edge/path
            & $\detsign{} = +1$: orientation-preserving. Positive parity is necessary
                  for endorsement flow; admissible endorsement paths also satisfy the local
                  vouch gate on actor-directed legs. \textbf{(---)}
                  \zcref{prop:epoch:standing-support-preservation,def:epoch:effective-act-contribution}. \\

Negative edge/path
    & $\detsign{} = -1$: orientation-reversing. Carried in the $\negreg{}$
      register; excluded from output. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:epoch:double-cover-bfs-state}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{SVD and Path Scoring}} \\
\midrule

$\svdone{M}, \svdtwo{M}, \svdthree{M}$
    & Singular values, $\svdone{} \geq \svdtwo{} \geq \svdthree{} \geq 0$. For
      the stored $3\times3$ slice: $\svdthree{}/\svdone{} < 0.05$ full-mask,
      $\leq 0.22$ worst case (\zcref{prop:graph:rank-two-constraint}). For the
      $2\times2$ path-view, the signed SVD yields $\svdone{} \geq \svdtwo{} > 0$
      and the orientation bit $\detsign{}$. \textbf{(---)} \\

$\condnum{M}$
    & Condition number $\svdone{}/\svdtwo{} = 1/\cohratio{}$. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{cor:graph:condition-number-submultiplicativity}. \\

$\cohratio{M}$
    & Coherence ratio $\svdtwo{}/\svdone{} \in (0,1]$. Post-ranking diagnostic;
      enters no scoring, endorsement-flow, or CAN formula. Uses $\varrho$; CAN redundancy uses
      $\mu$. \textbf{(---)} \zcref{def:graph:coherence-ratio}. \\

$\modeangle{M}$
    & Dominant mode angle $\arctan|U_{10}/U_{00}| \in [0,\pi/2]$. Post-ranking
      diagnostic. Uses $\vartheta$; distinct from $\numeraire$.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{def:graph:dominant-mode-angle}. \\

$\divpref$
    & Terminal raw SVD path diversity preference $q \in [0,1]$,
      canonical default $\numval{const.graph.divergence_preference.exact}$.  Guild-reimplementable for raw
      sorting; no standing read-site.  Distinct from the
      comparator $\standing{}$ ($\alpha$). \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:graph:svd-path-score}. \\

$\svdscore{p}$
    & SVD path score; at $q=\tfrac12$ factorizes per edge via $\sqrt{|\det|}$,
      the identical raw per-edge weight $\dampedweight{e}$ shared with the
      raw signed double-cover service. \textbf{(---)} \zcref{def:graph:svd-path-score}. \\

$\detscore{e}$
    & Per-edge determinant score $|\det(\pathview{e})|^{1/2}$. Reference
      \tierfull{} $\approx 0.28$--$0.36$; \tiermarginal{} $\approx 0.07$--$0.08$;
      Self/Reputation standing-dependent, supremum $\wmax$. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{CAN and Attribution (\zcref{app:can})}} \\
\midrule

$\candepth{n}$ & Compositional depth. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:can:compositional-depth}. \\
$\canval{n}$
    & Canonical terminal CAN intrinsic value, from $3 \times 3$
      Frobenius norms; guild-reimplementable subject to mandatory
      invariants. Distinct
      from matrix $\matcanval{n}$: roman vs.\ bold. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:can:intrinsic-value}. \\
$\baseval{\ell}$ & CAN base value $\norm{\symbf{\Psi}_\ell}_F$. No temporal
      factor.  Canonical terminal default; host cache \tagbyproduct{}.
      \tagLtwo{} \zcref{def:can:base-value}. \\
$\trans{n}$ & Transmission coefficient $\sat{\meanedgenorm{n}} < 1$.
      \tagLtwo{} \zcref{def:can:transmission-coefficient}. \\
$\sat{x}$ & Saturation map $\operatorname{sat}(x)=x/(1+x)$; the same M\"obius
      map $x/(1+x)$ as the bond kernel $\bondkernel{}$. \textbf{(---)} \\
$\meanedgenorm{n}$ & Mean of outgoing $3\times3$ Frobenius norms. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{eq:can:transmission-coefficient}. \\
$\redundancy{n}$ & Redundancy ratio ($\mu$): unique-to-total reachable leaves.
      \tagLtwo{} \zcref{def:can:redundancy-ratio}. \\
$\depweight{n}{c_i}$ & Dependency weight, $\propto$ outgoing Frobenius norm;
      $\sum_i \depweight{n}{c_i} = 1$. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:can:dependency-weights}. \\
$\bot$ & CAN void: $\baseval{\bot} = \epsilon_\bot \numrel{const.can.void_base.num}$. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:can:void-node}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Matrix CAN (Phase 3,
\zcref{subsec:can:matrix-extension})}} \\
\midrule
$\matcanval{n}$ & Matrix CAN value $\symbf{V}(n) \in \R^{3\times3}$. \tagLtwo{} \\
$\svdtrans{n}$ & SVD transmission matrix
      $U\operatorname{diag}(\sat{\svdone{}},\sat{\svdtwo{}},\sat{\svdthree{}})\,V^T$.
      \tagLtwo{} \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Temporal Dynamics}} \\
\midrule
$\acttime{\actof{e}}$ & Structural Lamport time.  Binding because complete-act
      time, projected path causality, and formation consume it;
      independent of any audit position $\logpos{e}$. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{ax:graph:act-causality,def:graph:authoritative-act-order}. \\
$\tau_e$ & Raw graph maturity scalar $\in [0,1)$. Consumed by terminal
      feed/raw bridge traversal; absent from projected standing and the
      CAN. \tagLtwo{} \zcref{def:graph:edge-projection-maturity}. \\
$\tentropy{}$ & Raw temporal entropy used by terminal raw edge
      weighting; $\tentropy{} = 0$ at $\tau_e = 0$. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:graph:temporal-entropy}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Thermodynamic Boundary}} \\
\midrule
$\invtemp$ & Inverse temperature $\invtemp \numrel{const.activation.beta_2ln2.exact} \numrel{const.activation.beta_2ln2.num}$; two granularities
      (per-edge; per-creator-epoch).  Binding because it enters the
      projected standing core as well as terminal raw damping.
      \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{ax:epoch:thermodynamic-boundary,%
def:epoch:responsive-vouch-activation}. \\
$\boltzfactor{H}$ & Boltzmann factor, applied once at observation
      boundaries. \textbf{(---)} \\
$\dampedweight{e}$ & Canonical raw edge weight $\detscore{e}\cdot\sqrt{1+\tau_e^2}\cdot
      \boltzfactor{\tentropy{e}}$.  Terminal default for feed, raw
      bridge, and raw signed traversal; it enters no standing formula.
      Formula \tagLtwo{}; host cache \tagbyproduct{}.
      \zcref{def:epoch:damped-edge-weight}. \\
$\epochentropy{C}$ & Per-creator-epoch entropy. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{eq:transport:epoch-entropy}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Activation Functions}} \\
\midrule
$\clampsigmoid{x}$ & $\invtemp$-scaled sigmoid $\sigmoid{\invtemp x}$; alias
      $\fpl{x}$; in $(0.5,1)$. \textbf{(---)} \\
$\clamptanh{x}$ & Sign-preserving clamp; alias $\fpm{x}$; in $(-1,1)$.
      \textbf{(---)} \\
$\fpm{x},\fpl{x}$ & Signed / non-negative master-formula aliases. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:graph:sentiment-slice}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Terminal Raw Signed Double-Cover State}} \\
\midrule
$\posreg{v}$ & Raw positive-parity register for a caller-selected
      terminal raw traversal; max positive-parity product to $v$;
      init $1$ at source.  Not standing flow. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:double-cover-bfs-state}. \\
$\negreg{v}$ & Raw negative-parity register; retained so a later negative
      edge can convert a negative prefix to positive.  Terminal
      guild/raw-service state; not standing flow. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:double-cover-bfs-state}. \\
$\wspam$ & Raw spam floor weight $\numrel{result.spam.weight.num}$; terminal
      diagnostic.  Formula \tagLtwo{}; host cache \tagbyproduct{}.
      \zcref{subsec:verification:spam-resistance}. \\
$\wmax$ & Raw Reputation component supremum $\numrel{bound.raw.wmax.num}$; the raw
      edge-weight ceiling (\zcref{thm:graph:raw-weight-ceiling}).  Formula
      \tagLtwo{}; host cache \tagbyproduct{}. \\
$\wmaxop$ & Raw Tribal/\tierfull{} Opinion ceiling $\numrel{bound.raw.wmaxop.num}$.
      Formula \tagLtwo{}; host cache \tagbyproduct{}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Layer 1: Epoch Architecture}} \\
\midrule
$\logpos{e}$ & Audit position $\in \NatZero$ under $\idorder$.  No
      standing, scoring, or title formula consumes the position itself.
      \tagverify{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:log-position}. \\
$\idorder$
      & Identity-key order, an optional audit tie-break for replay; not a
      scoring input, since the authoritative order fixes complete-act projected
      times and standing-path causality
      (\zcref{def:graph:authoritative-act-order,%
lem:graph:ordered-replay-determinism}). \tagverify{} \\
$q$ & Authored act: the atomic public record and unit of admission, ordering,
      action count, and $\safethresh$-debit; edge projection $\actedges{q}$ (one
      binary edge, or two role-labelled A/T hyper-edge projections). \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:authored-act,ax:graph:authored-act-ontology}. \\
$\actid{q}$ & Act identifier
      $\mathsf{act}(\operatorname{author}(q),s_q,\operatorname{family}(q))$;
      contains no host time or minted target, so it precedes ordering, and mints
      nodes as $\mintid{q}$. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:act-identifier}. \\
$\actedges{q},\ \actof{e},\ \edgerole{e},\ \edgeid{e}$ & Edge projection of act
      $q$; the parent act of a projection $e$; its role (binary, A, or T); and
      its identifier $\mathsf{edge}(\actid{q},\edgerole{e})$. An edge projection
      owns only incidence and role. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:act-edge-projection}. \\
$\edgeincrement{k}$ & Epoch edge increment $\Delta E_k=\bigcup_{q\in\actsequence{k}}\actedges{q}$;
      the projected graph write, $E_k=E_{k-1}\cup\edgeincrement{k}$.  It is
      \emph{not} what the epoch budget counts: that is
      $\lvert\actsequence{k}\rvert\le\epochlen$, denominated in acts, and a
      hyper-edge act contributing two projections still spends one unit
      (\zcref{def:epoch:epoch-act-budget}). \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:network:write}. \\
$\actpayload{q},\ \payloadcommit{q}$ & Act-owned removable payload projection and
      its retained commitment; per-act byte bound
      $\operatorname{len}(\operatorname{encode}(\actpayload{q}))\le\maxpayload$;
      controller is the author. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:act-payload-projection}. \\
$\actparents{q},\ \actprotocolrefs{q}$ & Non-removable public causal parents and
      protocol references, structural fields of $\actbody{q}$; the settlement
      reference is their settlement-family instance. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:act-causal-parents,def:graph:settlement-act-reference}. \\
$\acttime{q}$ & Host-assigned authoritative logical time
      $\symbb{T}\sp{\mathrm{act}}\sb{q}$, finalization metadata of the accepted
      act; an edge projection inherits it as $\acttime{\actof{e}}$, never as an
      edge-owned clock. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:act-incidence-causality,def:graph:authoritative-act-order}. \\
$\actsequence{k}$ & Authoritative ordered authored-act sequence of epoch~$k$;
      $\acttime{q}$ assigned by position; agreement on $\actsequence{k}$, not merely on the
      record set, is required. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:authoritative-act-order}. \\
$\actdeps{q},\ \actdepscommit{q}$ & Actor-authored dependency list and its binding
      commitment; a removable projection whose commitment residue is retained on
      tombstone. \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:graph:act-dependency-projection}. \\
$\precommit{q},\ \verifiedact{q},\ \approvewitness{q}$ & Proposal
      pre-commitment, host-salted verified act, and Actor approval witness of the
      admission handshake. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:proposal-pre-commitment,def:graph:approval-witness}. \\
$\fraudproof{q}$ & Ordering fraud proof: an ordinary full opening of the dependency
      projection; succeeds iff $\neg\depok{k}{q}$, establishing host
      non-compliance without rewriting finalized state. \tagverify{}
      \zcref{def:graph:ordering-fraud-proof}. \\
$\epochlen$ & Epoch act budget $N_{\mathrm{epoch}}$, denominated in accepted
      authored acts $|\actsequence{k}|$. Distinct
      from $\actcount{i}$. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:epoch-act-budget}. \\
$\snapbuf$ & Snapshot buffer / frontier-stability depth $\delta_{\mathrm{pos}}$.
      Chosen to exceed Layer~0 settlement-ordering uncertainty so the weld
      samples a settled value (\zcref{lem:comparator:frame-stability}).
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{post:epoch:final-edge-set}. \\
$\maxpayload$ & Maximum payload byte length; the sole content-related Layer~1
      constant. Payload carriage and terminality are
      \zcref{def:graph:act-payload-projection,prop:graph:removable-projection-invariance}.
      \tagclosure{} \\
$\safefloor$ (safety wall)
      & Safety wall $\safethresh/\numeraire$: W2a's comparator, the
      target-activation live/frozen boundary, the freeze key, and the
      width-fence pin.  Not the policy door.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:safety-floor}. \\
$\actstamp{q}$ / $\epochstamp{k}$
      & Boundary-frozen measurements: per-record stamp and action-weighted
      epoch stamp. Measurements, never floors; never debited. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:final-act-stamps}. \\
$\doorheadroom{k}$
      & Door headroom $\sum_{q\in \actsequence{k}}(\actstamp{q}-\partfloor)$:
      congestion diagnostic, consumed by no formula. \tagverify{}
      \zcref{def:network:door-headroom}. \\
$\marginfactor$ & Published margin factor; chartered $\numval{const.epoch.margin.num}$ and
      carried in the constants ledger. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:safety-threshold}. \\
capacity & Bootstrap capacity bound $\burncap$
      (\zcref{def:comparator:bootstrap-capacity}) vs.\ ledger balance capacity
      $\lfloor\burnbal{}/\safethresh\rfloor$ --- different economies;
      qualify at first use. \\
member & App~A economic participant (gate-clearing actor) vs.\ chat membership
      (terminal fold, \zcref{def:nodes:canonical-membership-fold}) --- never
      merge. \\
$\floorburn{i}$ ($\hat B_i$)
            & Num\'eraire-reduced gross imported frame value
                  $\burnval{i}/\numeraire$ (units: actions).  Terminal ledger
                  diagnostic; no admission or standing formula consumes
                  it --- W1 reads the residual $\burnbal{i}$.  Not an
      edge-claim floor. \tagLtwo{} \\
$\refstanding{i}$ ($\hat\alpha_i$)
            & Numéraire-reduced comparator $\standing{i}/\numeraire$ (dimensionless).
      Binding read-sites: the projected target activation
      $g_{\mathrm{vch}}(\refstanding{i})$, the action stamps, the
      safety wall, and W2.
      Canonical \texttt{\textbackslash refstanding}. \tagclosure{} \\
$\ampfactor{i}$
            & Universal amplifier $1+\refstanding{i}$, terminal readouts only;
      dimensionless by construction. The raw full-coordinate amplifier is
      prohibited; the standing recursion's self-weight $1$ is a count and exempt.
      Canonical \texttt{\textbackslash ampfactor}. \tagLtwo{} \\
$\bondkernel{i}$ ($p_i$)
    & \textbf{Bond intensity}: the M\"obius bond kernel
      $\bondkernel{i} = \standing{i}/(\numeraire+\standing{i})$ (full
      coordinates), reduced $\bondkernel{} = \refstanding{}/(1+\refstanding{})$
      in \zcref{app:dynamics}. The most-used derived quantity of \zcref{sec:nodes}; the same
      M\"obius map $x/(1+x)$ as the saturation map $\sat{}$, in standing
      coordinates. \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:raw-self-edge-reading}. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Coupled Dynamics (\zcref{app:dynamics})}} \\
\midrule
$\vouchactivation{x}$ ($g_{\mathrm{vch}}(x)$)
    & Smooth responsive projected-vouch activation
      $g_{\mathrm{vch}}(x)=\vouchcore{p(x)}^{\actexponent}$, with
      $p(x)=x/(1+x)$.  The analytic base object used above the safety
      wall; not the raw Reputation damped weight.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:responsive-vouch-activation}. \\
$\wallactivation{x}$ ($\bar g_{\mathrm{vch}}(x)$)
    & Effective activation used by every standing stage,
      $\bar g_{\mathrm{vch}}(x)=g_{\mathrm{vch}}(\max(x,\safefloor))$:
      constant below the safety wall, responsive above it, and continuous
      at the wall.  \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:epoch:safety-wall-clamped-activation,%
      prop:dynamics:safety-wall-clamp}. \\
$\vouchcore{p}$ ($\tilde g$)
    & Normalized deployed activation core on the kernel variable~$p$.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:responsive-vouch-activation}. \\
$\loggain{x}$ ($\lambda_Q(x)$)
    & Clean full-depth reduced-standing gain envelope certified by
      Fcert2.  It screens every active maximizing path through at most
      $\hopmax$ hops.  It is not the exact per-hop gain.
      Not a reward or return.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{prop:dynamics:clean-gain-domination}. \\
$\vouchgain{x}$ ($\lambda_{\mathrm{vch}}(x)$)
    & Exact deployed per-hop reduced-standing log-gain of the projected
      activation.  Used by the path-incidence Jacobian.
      \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:dynamics:tilt-gain-coordinates,%
      lem:dynamics:transport-derivative-propagation}. \\
$\vouchpgain{p}$ ($\kappa_{\mathrm{vch}}(p)$)
    & Exact projected p-coordinate gain.  Related by
      $\lambda_{\mathrm{vch}}=(1-p)^2\kappa_{\mathrm{vch}}$.
      Used in projected p-Schwarzian and synchronized-margin formulas.
      \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{def:dynamics:tilt-gain-coordinates}. \\
$\crossgap{\alpha}$ ($\Phi_\times(\alpha)$)
            & Fixed-point crossing gap $\ell-R$: the strictly convex discriminant whose
                  unique zero is the scalar fixed point. Distinct from elasticity
                  $\elast{}$.
                  \textbf{(---)} \zcref{thm:dynamics:conserved-standing-existence}. \\
$\gainkernel{p}$ ($K(p)$)
            & Gain kernel; $\loggain{} = (1-p)^2\gainkernel{}$. Capacity $K_i$ is
                  retired; do not recoin casually.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{eq:dynamics:scalar-row-map}. \\
$\Schwarz{\vouchactivation{}}$
    & Schwarzian operator on the projected activation; its certified sign
      partition classifies the contraction-free residual only
      (\zcref{prop:dynamics:responsive-vouch-criticality-partition}). An operator,
      never calligraphic
      (settlement $\settlement$), never actor-subscripted (centrality
      $S_C$). \textbf{(---)} \zcref{thm:dynamics:responsive-schwarzian-freedom}. \\
$\refrate{i}$ ($\hat r_i$)
    & Reduced commitment rate $\commitrate{i}/\numeraire$; parallels
      $\refstanding{}$ and $\floorburn{}$. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{subsec:dynamics:within-epoch-indices}. \\
$\endorsemean{i}$ ($\bar r_i$ family)
            & Endorser weight-mean rate: $\endorsemean{i}$, per-channel
                  $\endorsemean{ik}$, and leave-$k$-out $\endorsemean{-k}$. Never
                  $\pooledrate{}$, which is action-mass pooled and agrees only on uniform
                  activity. \textbf{(---)} \zcref{eq:dynamics:allocation-aggregates-rate}. \\
$\endorsermass{i}$ ($\varSigma_i$)
    & Endorser structural mass (App~D; was bare $T_i$, renamed to free
      $T_i$ for bridge targets). Always subscripted or applied; never the
      summation operator. \textbf{(---)} \\
$\ratespan$ (rate span)
    & Reduced-rate dispersion $\hat r_{\max} - \hat r_{\min}$: an
      additive spread, never the hull ratio $r_{\max}/r_{\min}$ (see the
      collision register); linked by $\ratespan=\hat r_{\min}(\mathrm{hull}-1)$,
      never merged.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{thm:dynamics:certified-conserved-standing-uniqueness}. \\
$\loggain{1} \numrel{const.dynamics.loggain_1.num}$
            & Canonical-gate log-gain landmark ($\partfloor=1$); equal to
                  $\loggain{1}$ at the canonical default
                  (\zcref{rem:dynamics:elasticity-profile}).
                  \textbf{(---)} \\
$\mathrm{hull}=r_{\max}/r_{\min}$
    & Rate-hull \emph{ratio}. Distinct from the additive
      dispersion $\ratespan$ (\emph{never} the hull ratio --- see the collision
      register); related by $\ratespan=\hat r_{\min}(\mathrm{hull}-1)$.
      \textbf{(---)} \\
$\chancap$ ($\kappa_{\max}$)
    & Per-channel motif cap
      $\tfrac14\vouchgain{x^\ast}\ratespan$ from the quarantined motif analysis;
      distinct from the
      condition number $\condnum{}$, the projected p-gain
      $\vouchpgain{}$, and the Layer~0 confidence price.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{subsec:dynamics:quarantined-residuals}. \\
$\endorsegraph$ ($\symcal{E}$)
    & Endorsement (coupling) graph; its directed cycles are the
      oscillation locus. Analysis-only under conserved allocation.
      \textbf{(---)} \zcref{subsec:dynamics:quarantined-residuals}. \\
$\lyapone$ ($\ell_1$)
    & First Lyapunov coefficient (Neimark--Sacker / reduced-map
      criticality datum); quarantined. \textbf{(---)}
      \zcref{subsec:dynamics:quarantined-residuals}. \\
$\standingcert{k}$
            & \textbf{Published conserved standing certificate}: the evaluated
                  fence, an upper bound on the maximum absolute Jacobian row
                  sum of the epoch map over $\hullbox{k}$.  Rung validity
                  requires $\marginfactor\standingcert{k}\le1$ with
                  $\marginfactor\numrel{const.epoch.margin.exact}$; single-step $\infty$-norm control.
                  Closed form and graph-reading only through $\locwidth{}$;
                  it is not an interval enclosure, and there are no interval
                  transcripts to accept
                  (\zcref{rem:dynamics:certificate-is-the-fence}).  Scalar and
                  verdict are \tagclosure{}.
                  Calligraphic with row subscript, distinct from
                  $\gainkernel{p}$ and $\chancap$.
                  \zcref{def:dynamics:conserved-standing-certificate}. \\
$\mathfrak c_k$
            & Exact $\infty$-norm Lipschitz factor of the epoch map on its
                  certified box, satisfying
                  $\mathfrak c_k\le\standingcert{k}$.
                  Analysis quantity; the published computable object is
                  $\standingcert{k}$.  \textbf{(---)}
                  \zcref{thm:dynamics:certified-conserved-standing-uniqueness}. \\
$\locwidth{k}$ ($W_{\mathrm{loc}}^{(k)}$)
            & \textbf{Binding local contributing width}: max over live
                  target rows of the
                  additive width of the admitted source-rate set.  Feeds
                  the width fence and safety-threshold rule, so it
                  is binding:
                  $\norm{DF}_\infty\le
                  \numval{const.standing.rival_factor_2.exact}\wallgaincap
                  \tiltcum{\suppdepth}{\tiltstrength{k}}\locwidth{}$ ---
                  \emph{two}-sided, the factor being the price of rival
                  allocation and not an artifact of the profile
                  (\zcref{rem:dynamics:rival-factor-two}).
                  Additive, never a ratio.  Distinct from
                  $\transportentry{}{}$ ($W_{\mathrm{end}}$) and the registers
                  $\posreg{}/\negreg{}$: subscript ``loc''.  \tagclosure{}
                  \zcref{def:dynamics:local-width,thm:dynamics:hop-profile-width-fence}. \\
$\transcount{i}$
            & \textbf{Transported action count} of target row~$i$: the
                  mediant's denominator,
                  \[
                      \transcount{i}
                      =
                      \sum_{u}
                      \transportentry{u}{i}\,\actcount{u}.
                  \]
                  Every source, the target's own row included --- transport is
                  conserved and the diagonal is a destination, so there is
                  nothing to exclude and no ratio to normalize by.  The
                  companion $\transbal{i}$ is the same sum over balances.
                  \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:conserved-standing-map}. \\
$\minsafewall{W}$ ($\rho_{\theta,\min}(W)$)
            & Minimum safety wall at contributing width~$W$ under the
                  clean full-depth gain screen:
                  $\loggain{\minsafewall{W}}=1/W$
                  before the chartered margin adjustment; the actual
                  threshold rule uses $1/(\marginfactor W)$; asymptote
                  $W/2$.  A safety-wall quantity, not a policy/effective
                  floor.
                  \tagclosure{} \zcref{cor:dynamics:minimal-safe-wall}. \\
$M_Q$, $M_{\mathrm{vch}}$ (App-D-local)
            & \textbf{Core margin}
                  $M_Q=\Schwarz[p]{Q_\eta}-\tfrac32K_\eta^2$: core-only
                  compatibility result, certified negative on the core
                  domain.  \textbf{Projected margin}
                  $M_{\mathrm{vch}}=\Schwarz[p]{G}-\tfrac32\vouchpgain{}^2$:
                  certified sign partition, positive below the published
                  bracket and negative above it.  Both scoped to
                  \zcref{app:dynamics}; collision: $\maxpayload$ always
                  subscripted.  \textbf{(---)}
                  \zcref{thm:dynamics:core-margin-limit,%
prop:dynamics:core-margin-negativity,%
prop:dynamics:responsive-vouch-criticality-partition}. \\
$\elastmax$
            & Certified elasticity ceiling $[\numval{bound.dynamics.elastmax_lo.num}, \numval{bound.dynamics.elastmax_hi.num}]$ with analytic cap
                  $\tfrac12+(\invtemp-1)^2/(8\invtemp)$
                  (\zcref{lem:dynamics:elasticity-cap}).  \textbf{(---)} \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}p{0.96\linewidth}@{}}{\footnotesize
  \emph{Conjectures where theorems would sit (by design).} The deployed
  activation's Schwarzian negativity is a \emph{proposition}, proved by a
  machine-checked interval certificate --- retained for the unpowered core, with
  the projected activation carrying a certified sign partition instead
  (\zcref{prop:dynamics:core-schwarzian-negativity,%
prop:dynamics:responsive-vouch-criticality-partition}). The oscillator,
  spectral, and Neimark--Sacker questions that would otherwise sit here are
  quarantined pending rederivation on the fixed-standing base
  (\zcref{subsec:dynamics:quarantined-residuals}); every deployed gate uses the
  split-invariant Wielandt bound. Status is the environment, not a tier tag.} \\

\midrule

\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}p{0.93\linewidth}@{}}{%
  \emph{Layer~0 surface (cited, not in machinery).} The reserve pool, the single
  reserve-receipt supply and its two classes, the redemption-rate floor $\varphi$ and
      its ceiling, the fee rate $\feerate$ and split $\livesplit$, the maturity cycle and lead
      $\matlead$, the deposit escrow, the supply fraction, net economic cost,
      the redeemable cost ratio, and the cycle burn fraction $\cycleburnfrac{}$ are
  \emph{Layer~0 surface objects}. The network may name and cite them in prose

  \attestationcref*{sec:operations}.} \\

\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Settlement and Ownership}} \\
\midrule
$\settlement$ & Recognized settlement
      $(\mathrm{Bid},\mathrm{Accept},\mathrm{Ratify})$; the canonical instance of
      accountability cost (\zcref{post:comparator:accountability-cost}). Order-free
      function of $(E_k,\prec)$. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{def:graph:settlement-recognition}. \\
$\titlecert{k}$ & Title certificate $\text{Items} \to V_u \cup \set{\void}$.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:graph:title-certificate}. \\
\texttt{settles}-pointer & Identity-key reference Accept/Ratify $\to$ Bid;
      metadata, not graph incidence. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{subsec:graph:settlement-lifecycle,def:graph:settlement-act-reference}. \\
Accept / Ratify & Settlement consent (seller) / commit (buyer); Relational,
      promoted, \tierhalf{}; $\detsign{} = \pm1$ (routing parity); commercial
      reputation via the \emph{stance} conjunction on
      $\operatorname{sgn}(p_d)$ (\zcref{rem:graph:settlement-reputation}).
      \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{edge:nodes:accept,edge:nodes:ratify}. \\
Withdraw / Rescind & Settlement cancels; Minimal \tiermarginal{}; $\detsign{} =
      +1$; CompGraph-excluded. \tagclosure{}
      \zcref{edge:nodes:withdraw,edge:nodes:rescind}. \\
Leave / De-invite & Conversational control edges; Minimal \tiermarginal{};
      $\detsign{} = +1$ forced; CompGraph-excluded; endorsement-inert
      (\zcref{rem:epoch:control-acts-resolve-to-self}).  Unconditionally
      appendable: no Layer-1 membership or authority precondition.
      Membership semantics are the terminal fold
      (\zcref{def:nodes:canonical-membership-fold}). \tagclosure{} as records;
      semantics \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{edge:nodes:leave,edge:nodes:hyper-deinvite}. \\
inviter revocation & Projection suppression: an author's own Invitation
      bundle toward a (Chat, Profile) incidence is suppressed while
      their $\prec$-latest record of the pair is a De-invite.
      Per-author, order-free, reversible, priced.  Feedback-relevant
      (via $\transportentry{}{} \to \standing{} \to$ gate): consume only.
      \tagclosure{} \zcref{def:epoch:inviter-revocation}. \\

$\guildpool$ & Guild liquidity pool $\symcal{L}$; funded by guild advertising

$R_C$ & Reward to creator $C$. \tagLtwo{}

$S_C$ & Betweenness centrality on the extended realizing forest. \tagLtwo{}

$S_C^{\mathrm{CAN}}$ & CAN-enriched centrality $S_C \cdot \canval{n_C}/V_{\max}$.

$V_{\max}$ & Max CAN value over realizing-path nodes. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:bridge:realizing-vmax}. \\
$I_C$ & Active influence; authored fraction of $\improveset{A}$,
      maturity-weighted. \tagLtwo{}
      \zcref{def:bridge:realizing-active-influence}. \\

$\campaignscalar{A}$ & Bridge campaign scalar; magnitude cancels in the

$\affinity{T,B}$ & Channel 1 raw affinity on $\posgraph$, depth $\leq 3$; carries the

$\endorsement{B,A}$ & Channel 2 endorsement, signed two-edge product. \tagLtwo{}

$\consent{A,B}$ & Channel 3 consent $\max(0,\posreg{}-\negreg{})$ at the Profile

$\circqual{T,B,A}$ & Per-target circuit quality

$\posgraph,\posedgeset$ & Terminal raw positive subgraph; derived from published

$\optbridge{i}$ & Optimal bridge $\arg\max_B \circqual{}$; superscript $*$ vs.\

$\realizingpath{i}$ & Extended realizing path. \tagLtwo{}

\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Symbol Collisions --- glyph shape}} \\
\midrule

$\standing{}$ vs.\ $\divpref$
    & Comparator $\alpha$ vs.\ diversity preference $q$. Different
      symbols, different roles. \\
$\standing{}$ vs.\ $\commitrate{}$
    & The comparator (bundle, $\alpha$) vs.\ the neutral source
      (fiber, $r_i$). Bundle $\neq$ fiber; see the word-level entry below. \\
$\refstanding{}$ vs.\ $\standing{}$
      & Numéraire-reduced $\hat\alpha$ vs.\ $\alpha$; hat
      distinguishes. \\
$\partfloor$ vs.\ spectral radii
            & Floors are $\polfloor/\safefloor/\partfloor$; radii are
                  $\specrad{M}$, $\specradperp$, $\specradNS$. The letter is shared;
                  the source form never is. \\
$\crossgap{}$ vs.\ $\elast{}$
            & Crossing gap $\Phi_\times$ vs.\ elasticity $\Phi(\cdot)$;
                  subscript and source form distinguish. \\
$\endorsemean{}$ vs.\ $\pooledrate{}$ / $\meanedgenorm{}$
            & Weight-mean rate $\bar r$ vs.\ action-mass pooled rate $\bar\rho$
                  vs.\ edge-norm mean $\bar w$; letters and source forms distinguish. \\
\tierfull{} vs.\ full mask
    & Full (routing tier) vs.\ full mask (stored shape); a Half edge is full-mask
      but Half-tier. \\
$\bleedparam$ vs.\ $\numeraire$
      & Bleed $\bleedparam$ vs.\ numéraire $\numeraire$; the former adoption-decay nu is retired. \\
$\safethresh$ vs App~D angles / retired threshold
      & Safety threshold $\safethresh$ is reserve/action and compared to gate-axis
      quantities only through $\numeraire$; App~D angles are subscripted;
      the retired coupled threshold names no live object. \\
$\actcount{}$ vs.\ $\epochlen$
    & $N_i$ vs.\ $N_{\mathrm{epoch}}$; always use the macros. \\
$\pathmatrix{p}$ vs.\ $\guildpool$
    & Path matrix $P(p)$ vs.\ pool $\symcal{L}$. \\
$\canval{}$ vs.\ $\matcanval{}$
    & Scalar $V(n)$ vs.\ matrix $\symbf{V}(n)$; roman vs.\ bold. \\
$\logpos{e}$ vs.\ $\acttime{\actof{e}}$
    & Audit position vs.\ Lamport time. \\
$\doorheadroom{}$ vs.\ $\epochentropy{}$
      & Door headroom $H_k$ vs.\ temporal entropy $\tentropy{}$: epoch subscript vs.\ τ subscript. \\
$\burnval{}$ vs.\ bare $B$
    & Frame fiber $B_i$ vs.\ generic proof matrix $B$; subscript/context. \\
$\burncap$ vs.\ $\burnval{}$
    & $B_{\max}$ vs.\ $B_i$; ``max'' subscript. \\
$\floorburn{}$ vs.\ $\optbridge{}$
    & $\hat B_i$ vs.\ $B^*_i$; hat vs.\ superscript-$*$. \\

% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Symbol Collisions --- word semantics}
  (the comparator's own vocabulary)} \\
\midrule

floor
            & \textbf{Four distinct objects, one word --- never an edge-claim.}
      $\varphi$ (Layer~0 redemption-rate floor, $\ratefloor{}$) $\mid$
                  $\numeraire$ (Layer~1 num\'eraire) $\mid$
                  $\partfloor$ (Layer~1 participation floor) $\mid$
                  $\partfloor\numeraire$ (the door price, raw units) $\mid$
      ``through the floor'' (the binding axiom: the whole exogenous anchor,
      \zcref{post:comparator:faithfulness}). $\floorburn{}$ (num\'eraire
      reduction) is legitimate. \textbf{An edge-claim is deterred by accountability
      cost (endogenous), never floored (exogenous).} The one sanctioned ironic
      use is ``the floor we cannot pour''
      (\zcref{ins:introduction:the-floor-we-name}) --- do not lint-correct it. \\

accountability vs.\ auditability
    & \textbf{A record's cost-bearing property} (its author can be held to it,
      \zcref{post:comparator:accountability-cost}) vs.\ \textbf{a
      computation's reproducibility} (it can be re-run by anyone,
      \zcref{rem:comparator:auditability};
      \attestationcref{post:interface:auditability}). Adjacent, not synonyms; do
      not merge. \\

standing (bundle vs.\ fiber)
    & \textbf{The comparator} (the shared-codomain object, $\standing{}$) vs.\
      the \textbf{neutral source} (the per-actor rate, $\commitrate{}$). A
      relabeling-fabricable per-actor ``influence'' is not the comparator; the
      comparator is the gauge-fixed cross-cluster field
      (\zcref{ax:comparator:inter-cluster}). \\

source cost vs.\ accountability cost
    & \textbf{Exogenous} (destroyed external value; breaks the gauge; closes;
      glyphs $\burnval{}$, $\numeraire$, $\polfloor$, $\safethresh$,
      $\partfloor$) vs.\ \textbf{endogenous} (a public
      self-defeating record; respects the gauge; bounds-never-closes; no glyph).
      The two costs the comparator stands on
      (\zcref{tbl:comparator:two-costs}). \\

coherence vs.\ stance
            & \textbf{The parity bit} $\detsign{} = \operatorname{sgn}(p_dp_i)$
                  (orientation of the sentiment map; gauge-invariant under the joint
                  sign flip, \zcref{lem:graph:quadrant-law}) vs.\ \textbf{the stance
                  marginal} $\operatorname{sgn}(p_d)$ and the positive-quadrant
                  person-vouch compilation requirement (the author's directional
                  verdict plus felt
                  positivity; the $D$-odd component). Routing and ranking read
                  coherence. Standing, settlement reputation, and bridge verdicts
                  read stance. $(-1,-1)$ equals $(+1,+1)$ in the first and is its
                  opposite in the second; coherent condemnation is never a vouch.
                  Never substitute one for the other. \\

payload bytes vs.\ content meaning
            & \textbf{Magnitude is Layer~1's; meaning is Layer~2's.} Layer~1 bounds the
                  byte length $\maxpayload$ and carries the bytes unread
                  (\zcref{def:graph:act-payload-projection}); payload state is terminal
                  (\zcref{prop:graph:removable-projection-invariance}). Guild payload formats own the
                  CBOR framing, schema, and grapheme limits. \\
parallel
            & \textbf{Bundle repetition} (\zcref{def:graph:authored-act-bundle}) vs.\
                  \textbf{parallel paths} (redundancy, max-product). Never merge. \\
Reference vs.\ referenced
                                    & The edge family (Review transposed, mints nothing,
                                          \zcref{edge:nodes:hyper-reference}) vs.\ the identifier status
                                          ``referenced'' ($v \in V$, \zcref{def:graph:anchoring}) vs.\
                                          ``reference band/parameters'' in calibration prose.
                                          Capitalization and context distinguish; never merge. \\
A-leg / T-leg
            & Hyphenated compounds naming hyper-edge legs by role
                  (Actor-sourced / terminal); tables write Family/A,
                  Family/T. Never bare A (advertiser) or T (target,
                  $\acttime{\actof{e}}$, tier). Layer-0/Layer-1/Layer-2 names appear
                  only inside taxonomy badges. \\
write
            & The protocol act: admission of a dependent set at closure
                  (\zcref{def:network:write}) vs.\ the Send family (ex-Write)
                  vs.\ ``append-only'' (a property of the store, never the
                  act). Layer~1 has no ontology of the unwritten. \\
door headroom
            & Congestion diagnostic $\doorheadroom{k}$: stamp surplus over the
                  door (\zcref{def:network:door-headroom}); an outcome, never a
                  dial; consumed by no formula. \tagverify{} \\
cluster vs.\ dependent set
            & \textbf{Cluster} is reserved for the social aggregate --- the
                  comparator's object (\zcref{ax:comparator:inter-cluster}).
                  \textbf{Dependent set} is the write unit
                  (\zcref{def:graph:dependent-act-set}). Never interchange them. \\
set price vs.\ retired min-price rule
            & \textbf{Set price} is the average over a dependent set and is
                  compared with the door; the individual safety floor remains
                  per-member. The retired min-price rule appears only in
                  historical notes. \\
unwritten candidates
            & The network names no lesser record, pending object, or demand
                  ledger before closure. What is not in the certificate is not
                  a Layer-1 object. \\
derived edge
            & \textbf{Certificate recomputation, never a record}
                  (\zcref{def:graph:derived-raw-edges}) vs.\ derived constants. Qualify. \\
genesis
    & Minted \emph{genesis record} (forms an identity key,
      \zcref{def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator}) vs.\ the grounded
      \emph{anchoring record} (no key formed;
      \zcref{def:graph:registration}) vs.\ the Layer~0
      \emph{genesis reserve} $E_0$.  The anchoring record is never a
      genesis. \\
referenced vs.\ anchored
    & $v \in V$ (some record cites $v$) vs.\ the class-specific anchor
      present (\zcref{def:graph:anchoring}).  A referenced, unanchored
      identifier is \emph{dangling} and fold-neutral
      (\zcref{lem:graph:dangling-neutral-fold}); never write ``exists''
      for the anchored sense. \\
bridge
            & Three senses, never merged: the \textbf{advertiser bridge} $B$
                  (\zcref{app:bridge} actor role); the \textbf{profile-bridged
                  discovery path} (\zcref{def:nodes:profile-bridged-discovery-path},
                  feed routing); and the retired ``bridge weight'' for the
                  Reputation component --- now the \textbf{bond weight}
                  (\zcref{subsec:dynamics:responsive-activation}). \\
reissuance (retired)
            & The bond is \emph{derived} from the certificate
                  (\zcref{def:graph:derived-raw-edges}), never appended; ``reissuance''
                  names the retired append mechanism and appears only in
                  changelogs. \\
husk
    & The persistent actor record after identity-severance and content-erasure:
      standing, title, and trust-edges, names and words gone
      (\zcref{ins:introduction:right-to-leave}). Not a deletion; a residue owed to
      others. \\
shelf vs corridor
            & The sub-gate band as a \emph{place} (steady-state residence ---
                  confined to the upper edge and the diluted,
                  \zcref{cor:gates:band-floor}) vs.\ a \emph{transit} (compensated
                  corridor, family-bounded).  Residence claims and
                  transit claims carry different theorems and monitors; never blur. \\

raw path vs.\ standing path
    & A raw path traverses Action-Graph legs for feed, raw bridge, or
      signed diagnostics.  A standing path is Actor-only, simple,
      causal, and each hop is one complete person-vouch act. \\

act vs.\ edge projection
    & An accepted authored act~$q$ is the atomic public record and owns
      authorship, payload, dependencies, causal declarations, approval,
      debit, count increment, stamp, and time.  An edge
      $e\in\actedges{q}$ is a graph projection owning only its incidence
      and role~$\edgerole{e}$; it inherits everything else from its parent
      act~$\actof{e}$.  Standing consumes acts; feed and CAN may consume
      edge projections. \\

causal parent vs.\ declared dependency
    & A causal parent is a non-removable public protocol reference
      ($\causalparent$, $\actparents{q}$).  A declared dependency belongs
      to the removable act dependency projection ($\declareddep$,
      $\actdeps{q}$).  Both constrain act order; only the dependency
      opening may be tombstoned. \\

act time vs.\ edge maturity
    & $\acttime{q}=\symbb{T}\sp{\mathrm{act}}\sb{q}$ is the authoritative
      logical time attached to the finalized act.  $\tau_e$ is the
      maturity of one edge projection's incidence, computed from the
      pre-act graph state.  Never merge them. \\

admission atomicity vs.\ standing atomicity
    & Admission atomicity writes both hyper-edge projections together.
      Standing atomicity interprets the matched pair together and
      forbids independent T-projection standing. \\

artifact context vs.\ author authority
    & A Chat, Content item, Comment, Message, Offer, Item, Type, or
      Profile may supply context inside an act.  Only the act's author
      supplies standing authority. \\

hop share vs.\ transport entry
    & $\hopalloc{r}{u}{j}{\standingvector}$ is one hop's apportionment of
      whatever mass is being carried at that hop; $\transportentry{u}{i}$ is
      the composite over all supported depths of source~$u$'s own conserved
      unit.  Both are simplex coordinates; neither is a weight that can be
      set independently. \\

tilt backoff vs.\ raw pruning
    & Lowering $\tiltstrength{k}$ reduces how sharply standing tilts the
      division, and reduces nothing else.  Raw traversal publishes no
      normative precision clip
      (\zcref{rem:sorting:raw-pruning-is-implementation}). \\

projected depth vs.\ raw depth
    & $\hopmax=4$ is the standing transport depth.  Raw $L=4$
      counts Action-Graph legs.  Same numeral, different units. \\

p-gain vs.\ reduced-standing gain vs.\ clean screen
    & $\vouchpgain{p}$ is $d\log g_{\mathrm{vch}}/dp$;
      $\vouchgain{x}=(1-p)^2\vouchpgain{p}$;
      $\loggain{x}=\lambda_Q(x)$ is the clean full-depth envelope. \\

dynamic safety vs.\ transition magnitude
    & $\marginfactor\standingcert{k}\le1$ proves contraction and box
      invariance.  It does not imply small
      $|\standing{i}^{(k)}-\standing{i}^{(k-1)}|$. \\

source-target no-stacking vs.\ cross-target rivalry
    & The clip simplex prevents several paths from stacking into one
      $(u,i)$ flow.  It does not conserve one source's delegated view
      across different target Actors. \\

initiator ownership vs.\ target consent
    & Initiator ownership proves who authored every projected hop.
      There is no Layer~1 target veto on inbound vouching. \\

core criticality vs.\ projected criticality vs.\ deployment safety
    & Core $Q$ retains negative compatibility results; projected
      $g_{\mathrm{vch}}$ has a sign partition; deployed safety is the
      conserved standing certificate. \\
clearance
            & \textbf{Function clearance} (distance of a certified quantity from
                  zero; the analysis-facing number) vs.\ \textbf{enclosure margin}
                  (worst accepted interval bound; certification efficiency).
                  Suite-wide convention
                  (\zcref{subsec:verification:graph-dependent-certificate}); never conflate. \\
screen vs.\ certificate
    & The prior screen $\tiltcum{\suppdepth}{\tiltstrength{k}}\le
      \numval{const.standing.prior_screen_cap.num}$ bounds contraction from the
      published profile alone, reading no graph whatever
      (\zcref{cor:dynamics:tilt-profile-prior-screen}); the per-epoch gate is
      the conserved standing certificate $\standingcert{k}$
      (\zcref{def:dynamics:conserved-standing-certificate}), which reads the
      graph through $\locwidth{}$.  Both are closed form --- the distinction is
      what they read, not what they cost.  Never conflate the screen with the
      operative certificate. \\
% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{Standard Notation}} \\
\midrule
$\norm{\cdot}$ & Frobenius norm (default) or Euclidean norm as context requires. \\
$\Nat,\NatZero,\IntPos,\R$ & $\symbb{N}$; $\symbb{N}_0$; $\symbb{Z}_+$;
      $\symbb{R}$. The codomain of the imported frame is $\R_{\geq0}$ --- the
      comparator's neutral line; it carries no dedicated glyph. \\
$\strset$ & String set $\symbb{S}$ (registry $\symbf{\Lambda}$ universe). \\
$\void$ & Empty set $\varnothing$. \\
$\rank$ & Standard matrix/tensor rank. \\

\end{longtable}

The two straddlers remain standing and title.  The standing
package adds binding intermediate values because W2 consumes their
result and their validity selects which relational schedule may take
effect
(\zcref{def:network:admission-closure,%
def:network:conserved-standing-package,post:transport:guild-grant}).
Proof transcripts remain verification evidence: they may be
recomputed or replaced by another proof of the same hash-bound package,
but no guild or host may override the committed base matrix, emission fractions,
certificate verdict, standing, or title.

\section{Verification Suite}
\label{app:verification}

This appendix exercises the protocol mechanisms on small, fully specified
graphs. Every intermediate quantity is computed from the definitions in
\zcref{sec:graph,sec:sorting,sec:transport,sec:scalability,app:can}.
Three classes of quantities are distinguished:
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
    \item \textbf{\AttrView{}:} $\norm{\symbf{\Psi}_e}_F$, CAN base values.
          Raw, no~$\tau$, no damping. Layer~1 inputs consumed by guilds.
    \item \textbf{\PathView{}:} $\detscore{e}$, $\detsign{e}$,
          $\sqrt{1+\tau^2}$. Raw internal; identical across Layer~1
          and Layer~2 consumers.
    \item \textbf{Boundary-observed:} $\dampedweight{e}$.
          Applied once at observation; used by sorting and endorsement flow in
          identical form.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Verification Scope and Numerical Rounding}
\label{subsec:verification:scope}
% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

This appendix distinguishes analytic theorems, verified interval
certificates, high-precision regressions, and non-normative probes.
Displayed decimals follow \zcref{rem:verification:numerical-rounding}: the
defining formulas and interval enclosures are normative; decimal examples
are printed only to the precision needed to preserve the claim they
illustrate.

Raw graph calculations remain separate from standing.  Tensor,
determinant, maturity, raw Reputation, feed, bridge, CAN, title,
membership, and payload regressions retain their declared terminal roles.
Edition-4 standing uses the final epoch ledger, the complete Actor-vouch
projection, the exact depth-two equilibrium, the clipped depth-three and
depth-four equilibria, and one final W1/W2 result.

\begin{remark}[Numerical Rounding]
    \label{rem:verification:numerical-rounding}
    Displayed decimals are rounded to the least precision that preserves
    the stated comparison, classification, or reproducible example;
    trailing digits that do not affect the claim are omitted.

    When an omitted digit could change a gate, sign, ordering, or certified
    conclusion, the defining formula or verified enclosure is normative and
    the paper prints enough digits to make that conclusion stable ---
    otherwise it states the enclosure rather than a point decimal.
\end{remark}

\begin{remark}[Certificate Reproducibility]
    \label{rem:verification:certificate-reproducibility}
    The certificate programs and their declared inputs are public and
    executable.  Semantic pins, independent derivative checks, and interval
    enclosures establish the reported claims.  Generated reports may be
    regenerated from source; cryptographic software authentication is a
    deployment concern and is not part of this mathematical verification
    suite.
\end{remark}

ensures no BFS register inflation.

\subsection{Tensor Computation}
\label{subsec:verification:tensor-computation}
% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Two edges computed in full; the remainder summarized.

\paragraph{Opinion ($e_2$), Tribal, \tierfull{}.}
$p_d = \numval{fixture.e2.direct.exact}$, $p_i = \numval{fixture.e2.indirect.exact}$. Full mask. Inner product: $\numval{result.e2.inner.num}$.

$\fpm{\numval{result.e2.inner.num}} = \sigmoid{0.873} \cdot \tanh(0.63) = 0.705 \times 0.558 \numrel{result.e2.core_pm.num}$.
$\fpl{\numval{result.e2.inner.num}} \numrel{result.e2.core_pl.num}$. Marginals: $\fpm{\numval{fixture.e2.indirect.exact}} \numrel{result.e2.marg_ind_pm.num}$, $\fpl{\numval{fixture.e2.indirect.exact}} \numrel{result.e2.marg_ind_pl.num}$,
$\fpm{\numval{fixture.e2.direct.exact}} \numrel{result.e2.marg_dir_pm.num}$, $\fpl{\numval{fixture.e2.direct.exact}} \numrel{result.e2.marg_dir_pl.num}$, $\fpl{1} \numrel{const.graph.fpl_baseline.num}$.

Stored $3 \times 3$:
\[
\symbf{\Psi}_{e_2}
= \begin{pmatrix}
    \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e2.marg_ind_pm.num} \\
    \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e2.core_pl.num} & \numval{result.e2.marg_ind_pl.num} \\
    \numval{result.e2.marg_dir_pm.num} & \numval{result.e2.marg_dir_pl.num} & \numval{const.graph.fpl_baseline.num}
\end{pmatrix}.
\]
$\norm{\symbf{\Psi}_{e_2}}_F = \sqrt{\numval{result.e2.frobenius_sq.num}} \numrel{result.e2.frobenius.num}$. \quad
$\baseval{e_2} \numrel{result.e2.frobenius.num}$.

Path-view (full mask):
$\pathview{e_2}
= \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} \\ \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e2.core_pl.num}
\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. \quad
$\det(\pathview{e_2}) = \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} \times \numval{result.e2.core_pl.num} - \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num} \times \numval{result.e2.core_pm.num}
= \numval{result.e2.pv_ad.num} - \numval{result.e2.pv_bc.num} \numrel{result.e2.pv_det.num}$.

$\detscore{e_2} \numrel{result.e2.detscore.num}$. \quad $\detsign{e_2} = +1$.

$\tau = \numval{fixture.e2.maturity.exact}$: $\tentropy{} \numrel{result.e2.entropy.num}$, $\boltzfactor{H} \numrel{result.e2.boltz.num}$,
$\sqrt{1+(2/3)^2} \numrel{result.e2.coherence.num}$.
$\dampedweight{e_2} = \numval{result.e2.detscore.num} \times \numval{result.e2.coherence.num} \times \numval{result.e2.boltz.num} \numrel{result.e2.weight.num}$.

\paragraph{Affinity ($e_7$), Epistemic, \tiermarginal{}.}
$p_d = \numval{fixture.e7.direct.exact}$, $p_i = \numval{fixture.e7.indirect.exact}$. Mask $(0,1,0,1)$. Inner product: $\numval{result.e7.inner.num}$.

$\fpm{\numval{result.e7.inner.num}} \numrel{result.e7.core_pm.num}$, $\fpl{\numval{result.e7.inner.num}} \numrel{result.e7.core_pl.num}$.
Marginals: $\fpm{\numval{fixture.e7.indirect.exact}} \numrel{result.e7.marg_ind_pm.num}$, $\fpl{\numval{fixture.e7.indirect.exact}} \numrel{result.e7.marg_ind_pl.num}$,
$\fpm{\numval{fixture.e7.direct.exact}} \numrel{result.e7.marg_dir_pm.num}$, $\fpl{\numval{fixture.e7.direct.exact}} \numrel{result.e7.marg_dir_pl.num}$.

Stored $3 \times 3$:
\[
\symbf{\Psi}_{e_7}
= \begin{pmatrix}
    0 & \numval{result.e7.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e7.marg_ind_pm.num} \\
    0 & \numval{result.e7.core_pl.num} & \numval{result.e7.marg_ind_pl.num} \\
    \numval{result.e7.marg_dir_pm.num} & \numval{result.e7.marg_dir_pl.num} & \numval{const.graph.fpl_baseline.num}
\end{pmatrix}.
\]
$\norm{\symbf{\Psi}_{e_7}}_F \numrel{result.e7.frobenius.num}$. \quad $\baseval{e_7} \numrel{result.e7.frobenius.num}$.

Path-view (softened Epistemic):
$\pathview{e_7}
= \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} \numval{result.e7.pv_a.num} & \numval{result.e7.core_pm.num} \\
  \numval{result.e7.pv_a.num} & \numval{result.e7.core_pl.num} \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. \quad
$\det(\pathview{e_7}) = \numval{result.e7.pv_ad.num} - \numval{result.e7.pv_bc.num} \numrel{result.e7.pv_det.num}$.
$\detscore{e_7} \numrel{result.e7.detscore.num}$. \quad $\detsign{e_7} = +1$.

$\tau = \numval{fixture.e7.maturity.exact}$: $\tentropy{} \numrel{result.e7.entropy.num}$, $\boltzfactor{H} \numrel{result.e7.boltz.num}$,
$\sqrt{1.5625} \numrel{result.e7.coherence.num}$.
$\dampedweight{e_7} = \numval{result.e7.detscore.num} \times \numval{result.e7.coherence.num} \times \numval{result.e7.boltz.num} \numrel{result.e7.weight.num}$.

\paragraph{Reputation component ($e_{1r}$), Identity, \tierfull{}.}
The stored $3 \times 3$ tensor is identical to the Declaration component
$e_1$ (\zcref{def:epoch:raw-self-edge-reading}):
$\symbf{\Psi}_{e_{1r}} = \symbf{\Psi}_{e_1}$ and
$\norm{\symbf{\Psi}_{e_{1r}}}_F \numrel{result.e1r.frobenius.num}$.
The path-view extraction is likewise identical:
$\detscore{e_{1r}} \numrel{result.e1r.detscore.num}$, $\detsign{e_{1r}} = +1$.
The difference is temporal: $\tau_{e_{1r}} = 0.50$ because Profile$_A$
has one prior incident edge ($e_1$) at the moment $e_{1r}$ is appended.
\[
\begin{aligned}
    \tentropy{0.50}       &= \ln 2 \numrel{result.e1r.entropy.num} \\
    \invtemp\tentropy{0.50} &= 2(\ln 2)^2 \approx 0.961 \\
    e^{-0.961}         &\numrel{result.e1r.boltz.num} \qquad
        \text{(maximum-entropy damping factor)} \\
    \sqrt{1 + 0.5^2}   &= \sqrt{1.25} \numrel{result.e1r.coherence.num} \\
    \dampedweight{e_{1r}} &= \numval{result.e1r.detscore.num} \times \numval{result.e1r.coherence.num} \times \numval{result.e1r.boltz.num} \numrel{result.e1r.weight.num}
\end{aligned}
\]
This $\numval{result.e1r.weight.num}$ is the raw bond weight for Alice at
$\standing{\text{Alice}} = \numval{fixture.seed.alice_rate.num}$
during the first boundary derivation. It will increase in future epochs as
$\tau_{e_{1r}} \to 1^-$ via repeated derivation
(\zcref{def:epoch:raw-self-edge-reading}); a raw feed quantity
only.

\paragraph{Parity observations.}
All nine reference graph edges have $\detsign{e} = +1$: every
parameter pair is positive and identity-mask or full-mask, placing
both diagonal entries in the same sign class. The Reputation component
$e_{1r}$ inherits $\detsign{} = +1$ from the shared tensor with the
Declaration component: both have $p_d = 1 > 0$ and
$p_i = 0.75 > 0$. Bond-component-extended examples
(\zcref{subsec:verification:path-computation}) add hypothetical
negative-sentiment edges to exercise the $\detsign{} = -1$ case.

\paragraph{Tier verification.}
\tierfull{} (excluding Reputation): $\detscore{} \in [\numval{result.e3.detscore.num}, \numval{result.e1.detscore.num}]$.
\tiermarginal{}: $\detscore{} \in [\numval{result.e7.detscore.num}, \numval{result.e5.detscore.num}]$. Gap: $\numval{result.tier.gap_lo.num}$--$\numval{result.tier.gap_hi.num}\times$.
The Reputation component $e_{1r}$ sits in \tierfull{} with the same
$\detscore{} \numrel{result.e1r.detscore.num}$ as the Declaration, confirming synchronisation.

\paragraph{\AttrView{} equalization.}
$\norm{\symbf{\Psi}}_F \in [\numval{result.e7.frobenius.num}, \numval{result.e8.frobenius.num}]$, ratio $\numval{result.tier.frob_ratio.num}$.
Both bond components share $\norm{\symbf{\Psi}}_F \numrel{result.e1.frobenius.num}$, within the
other \tierfull{} edges' range ($\numval{result.e3.frobenius.num}$--$\numval{result.e8.frobenius.num}$). Discrimination lives
in $\detscore{}$; attribution equity is preserved in the Frobenius
norm.

\subsection{Path Computation and Parity Verification}
\label{subsec:verification:path-computation}
% ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

\paragraph{Bob $\to$ Photo.}%
\phantomsection\label{ver:paths:bob-to-photo}
Direct: $W = \dampedweight{e_3} \numrel{result.e3.weight.num}$.

\paragraph{Bob $\to$ StreetArt.}%
\phantomsection\label{ver:paths:bob-to-streetart}
Via $e_3 \to e_4 \to e_6$ (length~3):
$W = \numval{result.e3.weight.num} \times \numval{result.e4.weight.num} \times \numval{result.e6.weight.num} \numrel{result.path.bob_streetart.num}$.
Two consecutive \tiermarginal{} legs compound to suppress the path.
This path traverses two passive-sourced legs ($e_4$: Content
$\to$ Comment, $e_6$: Comment $\to$ Type), each author-fixed at creation
(\zcref{ax:graph:passivity,lem:graph:passive-out-degree}) and counted
individually toward the length bound~$L$. A hyper-edge therefore
contributes~$2$ to path length, consistent with the determinant product
$\det(\pathmatrix{p}) = \prod_e \det(\pathview{e})$
(\zcref{thm:graph:determinant-product}).

\paragraph{Alice $\to$ StreetArt.}%
\phantomsection\label{ver:paths:alice-to-streetart-long}
Path~A: $e_2 \to e_4 \to e_6$ (length~3):
$W_A = \numval{result.e2.weight.num} \times \numval{result.e4.weight.num} \times \numval{result.e6.weight.num} \numrel{result.path.alice_long.num}$.

\phantomsection\label{ver:paths:alice-to-streetart-direct}%
Path~B: $e_7$ (length~1, direct Affinity):
$W_B \numrel{result.e7.weight.num}$.

$W_B/W_A = \numval{result.path.alice_ratio.num}\times$. The direct \tiermarginal{} edge dominates because
it avoids compounding two additional \tiermarginal{} determinants.

\paragraph{Relevance score.}%
\phantomsection\label{ver:paths:relevance-score}
Bob viewing Photo ($\standing{\text{Alice}} = \numval{fixture.seed.alice_rate.num}$,
$\refstanding{\text{Alice}} \numrel{result.seed.alice_refstanding.num}$ at $\numeraire = \numval{const.comparator.numeraire.num}$,
$\norm{\symbf{\symcal{T}}_{\text{Photo}}}_F \numrel{result.e2.frobenius.num}$):
\[
    S(\text{Bob}, \text{Photo})
    = \numval{result.e3.weight.num} \times \numval{result.seed.alice_boost.num} \times \numval{result.e2.frobenius.num} \numrel{result.path.relevance.num}.
\]

\paragraph{Two-hop parity verification.}%
\phantomsection\label{ver:parity:two-hop-example}

\paragraph{Hypothetical edges.}
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
    \item \textbf{Edge $e_{\mathrm{Acc}}$:} Alice $\to$ Dave (Accept,
    Relational, \tierhalf{}). $p_d = \numval{fixture.accept.direct.exact}$, $p_i = \numval{fixture.accept.indirect.exact}$,
    $\tau = \numval{fixture.accept.maturity.exact}$.
    $\det(\pathview{e_{\mathrm{Acc}}}) \numrel{result.accept.pv_det.num}$, $\detscore{e_{\mathrm{Acc}}} \numrel{result.accept.detscore.num}$,
    $\detsign{e_{\mathrm{Acc}}} = +1$, $\dampedweight{e_{\mathrm{Acc}}} \numrel{result.accept.weight.num}$.

    \item \textbf{Edge $e_{\mathrm{Rat}}$:} Dave $\to$ Carol (Ratify/A,
    Relational, \tierhalf{}). $p_d = \numval{fixture.ratify.direct.exact}$, $p_i = \numval{fixture.ratify.indirect.exact}$, $\tau = \numval{fixture.ratify.maturity.exact}$.
    $\det(\pathview{e_{\mathrm{Rat}}}) \numrel{result.ratify.pv_det.num}$, $\detscore{e_{\mathrm{Rat}}} \numrel{result.ratify.detscore.num}$,
    $\detsign{e_{\mathrm{Rat}}} = -1$, $\dampedweight{e_{\mathrm{Rat}}} \numrel{result.ratify.weight.num}$.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Parity product.}
$\detsign{p} = (+1)(-1) = -1$. Path matrix product:
$\pathview{e_{\mathrm{Acc}}}\pathview{e_{\mathrm{Rat}}}
= \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}\numval{result.parity.prod_a.num}&\numval{result.parity.prod_b.num}\\\numval{result.parity.prod_c.num}&\numval{result.parity.prod_d.num}\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$,
$\det \numrel{result.parity.prod_det.num}$, $\operatorname{sgn} = -1$ \okmark.

\paragraph{Double cover BFS trace (source = Alice, $L = 2$).}
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{@{}l c c l@{}}
    \toprule
    \textbf{Step} & $\posreg{}$ & $\negreg{}$ & \textbf{Action} \\
    \midrule
    Initialize & $\posreg{\text{Alice}} = 1$ & $\negreg{\text{Alice}} = 0$
        & All other at $(0, 0)$ \\
    Process $e_{\mathrm{Acc}}$ ($\detsign{}=+1$, $w=\numval{result.accept.weight.num}$)
        & $\posreg{\text{Dave}} = \numval{result.accept.weight.num}$ & $\negreg{\text{Dave}} = 0$
        & Parity preserved \\
    Process $e_{\mathrm{Rat}}$ ($\detsign{}=-1$, $w=\numval{result.ratify.weight.num}$)
        & $\posreg{\text{Carol}} = 0$ & $\negreg{\text{Carol}} = \numval{result.parity.register.num}$
        & Parity swapped \\
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
$\posreg{\text{Carol}} = 0$ in the raw double-cover trace, so the
negative-parity path would not output endorsement flow.  In the v0.18.3
endorsement-flow projection, the mixed-sign actor-directed Ratify edge
also fails the Vouch Predicate and is omitted before traversal.  Thus
$\transportentry{\text{Alice}}{\text{Carol}}=0$ for two independent reasons:
parity in the raw trace, and vouch-gating in the actual projection. \okmark

\paragraph{Self-loop neutrality: numerical.}%
\phantomsection\label{ver:parity:self-loop-neutrality}

Self-loop neutrality holds: the raw combined weight is $\numval{result.bond.cycle.num} < 1$, so
max-product registers do not inflate. The
authoritative-order guarantee of \zcref{prop:nodes:self-loop-neutral} is stronger and
does not depend on this numerical bound. \okmark

  \numval{result.e8.core_pm.num} & \numval{result.e8.core_pl.num} \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$.
$\det \numrel{result.e8.pv_det.num}$. $\detscore{} \numrel{result.e8.detscore.num}$. $\detsign{} = +1$. \tierfull{}.

Both $\dampedweight{}$ entries below use the reference edge's
$\tau = 0.50$ from \zcref{tbl:verification:reference-edges}; the ratio is
unchanged for any common $\tau$ because the same temporal factor
multiplies both masks.
